items.text: Develop CPLD for Server application and basic power sequence control.

key_values.label: 其他條件
key_values.text:
1. With bachelor’s degree of Electronics, EE, or CS.
2. With 3+ years HDL coding experience prefer (Preferable to Verilog).
3. Possess basic knowledge of Digital Circuit Design ( Combinational Logic, Sequential Logic, FSM, etc).
4. Familiar with PC industry standards: SPI, I2C, USB, SGPIO, etc.
5. Familiar with UVM to verify FPGA/ ASIC.
6. Familiar with C, C++, or Python.
7. Familiar with board level design is a plus.
8. With good English competency in 4 skills, Toeic 600+.
